Nora: Heads-up  scheduling a focused priming run for Zenith's dedicated pool Wed 14:00 UTC. Goal: quota sanity, autoscale handoff, 20m steady soak. Reply if conflict.
Ken: I can lead infra. Instance family: r-infer-nv100. Start 6 slots (customer bought 4), target p95 < 180ms for 96-token jobs.
Ibrahim: From CS: we'll coordinate a preflight with Zenith ops and validate SDK retry/backoff. I'll send the short checklist.
Sasha: I'll capture sample prompts for quality checks and run 30 traces during soak. Also want a tiny canary after provisioning.
env-bot: Provision event: pool-zenith-prime-03 created by ken at 1800004338  provisioning started.
Ken: Autoscaler profile: "steady-burst" (min 3, desired 6, max 9). Quota set to 1.6x expected steady qps for the test.
Nora: Test plan: 1) 4m smoke at 30% qps, 2) 10m linear ramp, 3) 20m steady with occasional 2x bursts, 4) 5m blast to 3x then cooldown. Capture per-route p50/p95, 429s, 5xxs, KV cache hits, and token cost.
Ibrahim: Preflight checklist for Zenith ops: API key scoped to pool, route pinned, SDK >= 2.4, cutoff contact, KMS decrypt validated. I'll send a one-pager.
Ken: Load command (k6): `k6 run --vus 40 --duration 20m load-zenith.js`
Sasha: If >0.7% 5xx during steady-state we abort and failover to shared. Also save traces for any >400ms reqs.
Nora: I'll post a short feedback sheet and tag renewals. After run we'll share dashboard links and a one-paragraph exec note.
Ken: All right, provisioning looks healthy. Will update when nodes green.
Ibrahim: Prep call scheduled 13:30 UTC with Zenith ops. See invite.
Nora: Thanks team  keep the #rollback channel ready.
